preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of caves is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of tunnels is between n and the maximum possible number of tunnels, inclusive.
The power required to beat the monster in cave i is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The power increase after beating the monster in cave i is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The caves connected by tunnel u_i and v_i are distinct and within the range of cave numbers.
No tunnel connects a cave to itself.

preconditions.expression: At least two tunnels come out of every cave.
preconditions.description: Each cave has at least two tunnels.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the smallest possible power the hero must start the level with to be able to beat all the monsters and pass the level.
